mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 80 degrees with clear skies near the Public Library. With the moon in its first quarter, it is a perfect night to spot the International Space Station passing over at 9:33 PM, moving from the Northwest near Verona High School toward the East and Fitchburg while reaching halfway up the sky.

The city is highlighting the VHAT cable channel for local government transparency and reminded residents that recreational vehicle parking requires staying 5 feet from property lines with proper screening.

This week is packed with local fun including trivia at Hop Haus on Tuesday and the Bogey Factory on Wednesday, plus the Verona Downtown Farmers Market on July 22 and Concerts in the Park starting this Thursday.
In a notable service call from July 14, officers performed a traffic stop where they discovered marijuana and a firearm after noticing a vehicle driving at night without headlights.
Today is the perfect day to grab a Chocolate Caramel Twist at Culver's, which remains open until 10 PM tonight. Tomorrow's flavor will be Mint Explosion if you are planning your next visit.
